reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes L11 and L12 are distinct, competing SRO types in CrCoNi, whereas the well-established SRO in this alloy is a single L12-type ordering tendency; the proposed L11-to-L12 transition is not physically supported.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and would decisively falsify the hypothesis, but it relies on measuring a structural feature (L11 SRO) that is not expected to exist in the baseline material.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is built on a fundamental misunderstanding of SRO in CrCoNi, leading researchers down an unproductive path.
